ruleDefinitions.name: Rare Remote Thread Creation By Uncommon Source Image
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon processes creating remote threads. Note: Unmapped fields: SourceImage, TargetImage

sequences.query: (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\cvtres\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\defrag\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\dialer\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\dnx\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\esentutl\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\expand\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\find\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\findstr\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\forfiles\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\gpupdate\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\installutil\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\lync\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\makecab\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\mDNSResponder\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\monitoringhost\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\msbuild\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\mspaint\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\ping\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\provtool\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\python\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\robocopy\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\runonce\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\sapcimc\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\smartscreen\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\spoolsv\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\tstheme\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\userinit\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\vssadmin\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\vssvc\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\w3wp\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\winscp\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (((SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\Defrag\.exe" OR SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\makecab\.exe") AND TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\conhost\.exe") OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\provtool\.exe" AND TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost\.exe") OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\userinit\.exe" AND TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe") OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\WINWORD\\\.EXE$") AND (TargetImage = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR TargetImage = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\")))) AND  NOT ((SourceImage = RGX("\\\\SysWOW64\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") AND (TargetImage = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\vmtoolsd\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\vmtoolsd\.exe")))
